name: New cleaner
description: Claims biodegradable ingredients and less plastic waste. Its bottle can be refilled. It has low odor and cleans everyday stains. Old stains may need a second pass.

name: Familiar cleaner
description: Claims fast cleaning of tough stains. It has a sharp smell and a single-use bottle.

name: Value cleaner
description: Claims basic cleaning at a low price. It has no added scent and a single-use bottle.

name: Fresh cleaner
description: Claims everyday cleaning and a lasting citrus scent. It has a single-use bottle.
